subject: AlgoSpark renewal — capacity reshuffle & staggered buffering
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Rita Patel <rita@algospark.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal discussion: right-sizing AlgoSpark Dedicated fleet for next year

Hi Rita —

As we approach your contract renewal, wanted to share a short read on a couple of capacity options that align with the usage signal we’ve observed in Q3. Attached is the raw utilization extract (algospark_utilization_q3.csv) so your infra folks can poke at the numbers. High level:

- Current committed pool: 120 GPUs
- Observed steady-state avg utilization: ~68%
- Daily p95 bursts driving tail contention up to 92–95%

Given your latency SLOs and the upcoming product launch, we see two pragmatic levers: a) a modest immediate tranche add to reduce p95 contention, or b) a reshuffle that converts some burst credits into a staggered buffer across next two quarters.

Quick next steps I propose:
1) Internal sizing review with Kimberly (cc’d) to convert the utilization profile into a tranche recommendation.
2) Deliver a mutual action plan and cost delta for the options.
3) If agreeable, we'll prepare the amendment + DocuSign.

Can you confirm whether you prefer an all-up capacity add or a staggered approach? I can put numbers behind both today.

Thanks —
Connor
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments: algospark_utilization_q3.csv (CSV, 84KB)
From: Rita Patel <rita@algospark.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@algospark.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-16T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: right-sizing AlgoSpark Dedicated fleet for next year

Connor —

Thanks for the quick note and the CSV. A couple of clarifying questions before we look at the amendment:

1) What exactly did you use as the baseline for p95? Is it requests/sec per GPU or aggregate token throughput?
2) Our finance team prefers smaller upfront spend — they pushed back on previous one-time tranche adds. Staggered is appealing if it doesn’t materially increase unit cost.
3) Any chance you can show a 6-month projection with both options and the expected cost delta vs. us staying at 120 and using burst credits?

Tom (cc) from infra will review utilization with our ops team — he may have concrete asks on placement and availability zones.

Rita
Head of Platform
AlgoSpark
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-18T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: right-sizing AlgoSpark Dedicated fleet for next year

Connor / Marissa —

I dove into the Q3 extract. Short answers to Rita's questions and a concrete recomm:

- Baseline: p95 was calculated on per-request latency (token-aggregated) across the inference gateway. We correlated high p95 windows to sustained batch jobs between 23:00–02:00 UTC.
- Observed behavior: 68% avg utilization but long-tail events increase transient queueing. One-time tranche of +24 GPUs brings p95 back into target for peak windows; however that requires higher upfront commitment.

Recommendation (staggered-buffering):
1) Immediate add: +12 GPUs (bring committed to 132) to blunt the upcoming launch risk window (Q1).
2) Review 60–90 days post-launch and add +12 GPUs in Q2 only if peak retention >85% on the new baseline.
3) If we see sustained p95 regressions despite +12, fall back to +24 immediate and offer a one-time ramp credit to soften first-quarter spend.

Estimated 6-month cost delta (approx):
- Option A (all-up +24): +$156k over 6 months
- Option B (staggered +12 now, +12 conditional): +$82k initial, +$78k if second tranche triggered (total similar but smoothed)

I attached a proposed tranche profile PDF that lays out the compute buckets, expected utilization bands, and SLA headroom assumptions. Also included is a draft mutual action plan template for legal/procurement (mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx).

If you want, I can convert the numbers into a line-item amendment for finance.

—Kimberly
Director, Deals Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_tranche_profile.pdf (7 pages), mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (18KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Rita Patel <rita@algospark.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-24T10:32:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: staggered buffering path + mutual action plan (ALG-472-RNW)

Rita —

Attached is a concise recommendation and the mutual action plan covering the timeline, acceptance criteria, and cost delta for Option B (staggered buffering). Key bullets:

- Immediate: deploy +12 GPUs to committed pool (132 total) effective first billing cycle after signature.
- 60–90 day telemetry window with joint checkpoints (weekly for first month, then biweekly).
- Conditional second tranche (+12) only triggers on documented >85% retention of p95 tail for 14 consecutive days.
- If AlgoSpark chooses immediate +24 instead, we propose a one-time 7% ramp credit to the first invoice.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ALG-472), proposal in Drive (https://drive.redwood.com/algospark/proposal_v2), DocuSign template for the amendment (https://www.docusign.com/templates/ALG-472-renewal).

Please review and let me know if finance/ops need alternate invoicing cadence. If you approve, I'll route the amendment to DocuSign today.

Thanks —
Connor
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (18KB)
From: Rita Patel <rita@algospark.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@algospark.ai>
Date: 2027-11-30T17:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: staggered buffering path + mutual action plan (ALG-472-RNW)

Connor / Kimberly —

This looks reasonable and aligns with our finance preference for smoothing. Tom and I reviewed the tranche PDF and the conditional trigger; we’re comfortable with the +12 now and the conditional review in Q2.

Please go ahead and send the DocuSign amendment. We’d like the first tranche to start with the December billing cycle. Also include an invoice stub when you forward the DocuSign link so our procurement team can route payment quickly.

Rita
Head of Platform
AlgoSpark
